body.script: /*BLGCHI001-C324: page loader lift -- bar ticks until window load, 4s absolute fallback, node removed after fade.*/ (function(){var root=document.getElementById('hm-loader'),bar=document.getElementById('hmLoaderBar');if(!root||!bar)return;var done=false,pct=0;var tick=function(){if(done||pct>=86)return;pct+=8;bar.style.width=pct+'%';setTimeout(tick,160);};tick();var lift=function(){if(done)return;done=true;bar.style.width='100%';setTimeout(function(){root.classList.add('done');setTimeout(function(){if(root.parentNode)root.parentNode.removeChild(root);},450);},250);};if(document.readyState==='complete')lift();else{window.addEventListener('load',lift);setTimeout(lift,4000);}})();

b:if.script: /*BLGCHI001-C342: Trending Now toggle lives inside the PopularPosts7 includable so Blogger renders it (a raw script child of b:section is dropped, leaving the box stuck collapsed with dead buttons). Binds immediately with a DOMContentLoaded retry + aria-expanded sync.*/(function(){function bind(){var box=document.getElementById('box-trending');var sh=document.getElementById('tampilkan');var hd=document.getElementById('sembunyikan');if(!box||!sh||!hd)return false;if(sh.getAttribute('data-hm-bound')==='1')return true;sh.setAttribute('data-hm-bound','1');function paint(){var open=box.style.display==='block';sh.style.display=open?'none':'';hd.style.display=open?'':'none';sh.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open?'true':'false');hd.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open?'true':'false');}sh.addEventListener('click',function(){box.style.display='block';paint();});hd.addEventListener('click',function(){box.style.display='none';paint();});var badge=document.getElementById('trending-count');if(badge){var n=box.querySelectorAll('li').length;if(n>0){badge.textContent=n;sh.setAttribute('aria-label','Show all '+n+' trending posts');}else{badge.style.display='none';}}paint();return true;}if(!bind()){document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',bind);}})();
